#include <cooperative_groups.h>
namespace cg = cooperative_groups;

__device__ __forceinline__ unsigned int __gsharp_add_cc(unsigned int a, unsigned int b, unsigned long long* carry) {
    unsigned int res;
    unsigned int c_in = (unsigned int)*carry;
    unsigned int c_out;
    asm volatile(
        ""add.cc.u32 %0, %2, -1;\n\t""
        ""addc.cc.u32 %0, %3, %4;\n\t""
        ""addc.u32 %1, 0, 0;""
        : ""=&r""(res), ""=r""(c_out)
        : ""r""(c_in), ""r""(a), ""r""(b)
    );
    *carry = c_out;
    return res;
}
__device__ __forceinline__ unsigned int __gsharp_sub_cc(unsigned int a, unsigned int b, long long* borrow) {
    unsigned int res;
    unsigned int dummy;
    unsigned int b_in = (unsigned int)*borrow;
    unsigned int b_out;
    asm volatile(
        ""sub.cc.u32 %1, 0, %3;\n\t""
        ""subc.cc.u32 %0, %4, %5;\n\t""
        ""subc.u32 %2, 0, 0;""
        : ""=&r""(res), ""=&r""(dummy), ""=r""(b_out)
        : ""r""(b_in), ""r""(a), ""r""(b)
    );
    *borrow = b_out & 1;
    return res;
}
struct DebugReduc_PhysicsVector;
__forceinline__ __device__ float ComputeMagnitude(DebugReduc_PhysicsVector v);

__noinline__ __device__ bool IsPositive(float value);

#define __GSHARP_STRUCT_DebugReduc_PhysicsVector__
struct DebugReduc_PhysicsVector
{
float X;
float Y;
float Z;
}
;
#endif
__forceinline__ __device__ float ComputeMagnitude(DebugReduc_PhysicsVector v){
return (float)sqrt((((v.X*v.X)+(v.Y*v.Y))+(v.Z*v.Z)));
}

__noinline__ __device__ bool IsPositive(float value){
return (value>0);
}

// Marshal array: data
int data_size = data.Length * System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.SizeOf(typeof(int));
CudaException.ThrowIfError(CudaDriverApi.cuMemAlloc_v2(out d_data, data_size));

System.Runtime.InteropServices.GCHandle handle_data = System.Runtime.InteropServices.GCHandle.Alloc(data, System.Runtime.InteropServices.GCHandleType.Pinned);
try
{
IntPtr p_data = handle_data.AddrOfPinnedObject();
CudaException.ThrowIfError(CudaDriverApi.cuMemcpyHtoD_v2(d_data, p_data, data_size));
}
finally
{
handle_data.Free();
}
pArg_data = System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.AllocHGlobal(IntPtr.Size);
System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.WriteIntPtr(pArg_data, d_data);
IntPtr[] kernelParams = [pArg_data];
CudaException.ThrowIfError(CudaDriverApi.cuLaunchCooperativeKernel(
hfunc,
gridDimX, gridDimY, gridDimZ, // Grid dim
blockDimX, blockDimY, blockDimZ, // Block dim
sharedMemBytes, // Shared mem
IntPtr.Zero, // Stream
kernelParams
));
// Copy back array: data
System.Runtime.InteropServices.GCHandle handleBack_data = System.Runtime.InteropServices.GCHandle.Alloc(data, System.Runtime.InteropServices.GCHandleType.Pinned);
try
{
IntPtr p_data = handleBack_data.AddrOfPinnedObject();
CudaException.ThrowIfError(CudaDriverApi.cuMemcpyDtoH_v2(p_data, d_data, data_size));
}
finally
{
handleBack_data.Free();
}
}
finally
{
if (d_data != IntPtr.Zero) CudaDriverApi.cuMemFree_v2(d_data);
if (pArg_data != IntPtr.Zero) System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.FreeHGlobal(pArg_data);
}
}
public static void Launch_CooperativePhysicsProcess_Device(IntPtr data, uint gridDimX = 1, uint gridDimY = 1, uint gridDimZ = 1, uint blockDimX = 1, uint blockDimY = 1, uint blockDimZ = 1, uint sharedMemBytes = 0)
{
using var _cudaCtxScope = new global::Kassyi.GSharp.Runtime.Transpiler.Pipeline.JitEngine.CudaContextScope();
IntPtr hfunc = global::Kassyi.GSharp.Runtime.Transpiler.Pipeline.JitEngine.GetOrCompileKernel(CooperativePhysicsProcess_CudaSource, "CooperativePhysicsProcess");
IntPtr pArg_data = IntPtr.Zero;
try
{
// Marshal device array: data
pArg_data = System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.AllocHGlobal(IntPtr.Size);
System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.WriteIntPtr(pArg_data, data);
IntPtr[] kernelParams = [pArg_data];
CudaException.ThrowIfError(CudaDriverApi.cuLaunchCooperativeKernel(
hfunc,
gridDimX, gridDimY, gridDimZ, // Grid dim
blockDimX, blockDimY, blockDimZ, // Block dim
sharedMemBytes, // Shared mem
IntPtr.Zero, // Stream
kernelParams
));
}
finally
{
if (pArg_data != IntPtr.Zero) System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.FreeHGlobal(pArg_data);
}
}
}
}
